title: Internship_Ioannina
summary: A personal internship repository documenting research into synthetic data generation methods for the medical field, using the Adult and Bank datasets to benchmark multiple tabular generators and evaluate their fidelity via metrics like KL divergence and quality reports. It directly runs SDV's single-table synthesizers (GaussianCopula, CopulaGAN, CTGAN, TVAE) alongside its evaluation and metadata APIs to generate and score synthetic data.
